rca_of_the_issue: Original issue: instructor (mbabaran@theboostpad.org) couldn't see submissions for cohorts they were assigned to. Root cause: instructor_id was only set when cohort was created, no way for super_admin to reassign. Fix: Added POST /api/cohorts/{id}/assign-instructor endpoint and frontend UI for super_admins to assign instructors to cohorts.
